recipes.name: Basic Bread

steps.title: Mix Ingredients
steps.description: Combine flour, water, yeast, and salt in a large bowl. Mix until no dry flour remains.

steps.title: Knead Dough
steps.description: Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Bulk Fermentation
steps.description: Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled in size.

steps.title: Shape Loaf
steps.description: Gently deflate dough, shape into a loaf, and place in a greased 9x5 pan.

steps.title: Final Proof
steps.description: Cover and let rise until dough is about 1 inch above the rim of the pan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 190°F.

recipes.notes: This is a simple, reliable recipe perfect for beginners.

recipes.name: White Sandwich Bread

steps.title: Hydrate yeast
steps.description: Combine milk and yeast in mixer bowl, stir to dissolve yeast.

steps.title: Mix
steps.description: Add flour, sugar, salt, and gluten. Mix on low to medium speed until full gluten development.

steps.title: Bulk ferment
steps.description: 1 book fold after 30 minutes, rest another 30 minutes, repeat fold, then rest again.

steps.title: Divide and shape
steps.description: Divide for large loaf or small loaf (500g). Shape into oblong bâtard, brush with oil before proofing.

steps.title: Final proof
steps.description: Proof at 27°C/80°F for 45–60 min, or at 21°C/70°F for 90–120 min.

steps.title: Score
steps.description: Single score down the center. Apply oil or egg wash before baking.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake according to White Sandwich Bread Baking Times and Temperatures. Remove from pans 5 minutes before done, finish on wire rack in oven with vent open.

recipes.notes: Yield ~1.0 kg dough. Timings based on Modernist Bread recommendations for white sandwich bread.

recipes.name: Pizza Dough

steps.title: Mix
steps.description: Combine flours, water, yeast, salt, oil, sugar, and malt. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.

steps.title: Knead
steps.description: Knead until smooth and elastic, about 8-10 minutes by hand or 5-6 minutes in a stand mixer.

steps.title: Bulk ferment
steps.description: Cover and let rise at room temperature until doubled, or cold ferment in refrigerator for 24-72 hours for better flavor.

steps.title: Divide and ball
steps.description: Divide dough into portions. Shape into tight balls and let rest 15-30 minutes before stretching.

steps.title: Stretch
steps.description: Gently stretch dough into a round, working from the center outward. Leave a slightly thicker edge for the crust.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Top as desired and bake at the highest temperature your oven allows, ideally 500-550°F or in a pizza oven at 700°F+.

recipes.notes: Cold fermentation produces better flavor and texture. For best results, make dough 1-3 days ahead.

recipes.name: Master Sourdough

steps.title: Autolyse
steps.description: Combine flour and water until shaggy. Cover and rest.

steps.title: Incorporate Levain
steps.description: Add mature liquid levain to autolysed dough. Mix until homogeneous.

steps.title: Add Salt, Bran, and Malt
steps.description: Sprinkle salt, wheat bran, and diastatic malt over dough. Mix until fully incorporated.

steps.title: Gluten Development
steps.description: Hand method: stretch-and-folds every 30 min, 6 folds total. Machine method: mix on low to combine, then medium speed until medium gluten development.

steps.title: Bulk Fermentation
steps.description: Allow dough to ferment until full gluten development. Verify using windowpane test.

steps.title: Divide
steps.description: Divide dough according to final shape: single boule/batard (no divide), small boules (500g pieces), or rolls (75g pieces).

steps.title: Preshape
steps.description: Preshape dough into loose rounds. Rest before final shaping.

steps.title: Final Shape
steps.description: Shape dough into final form (boule, batard, or roll).

steps.title: Final Proof
steps.description: Cold proof dough in refrigerator.

steps.title: Score
steps.description: Score dough as desired.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake according to oven type and loaf size.

recipes.notes: Diastatic malt is recommended for cold proofing longer than 12 hours. Multiply recipe by two for a miche. Windowpane test is the authoritative gluten development check. DDT 24-26°C (75-78°F).
